newsitem.title: MEXICO: B.A.T to take control of Moderna cigarette unit.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T to take control of Moderna cigarette unit.

text.p: Mexican conglomerate Empresas La Moderna said on Tuesday that it reached an agreement with B.A.T Industries in which B.A.T will buy a controlling 50 percent stake plus two shares in Moderna's cigarette unit Cigarrera La Moderna (CLM).
The deal also gives B.A.T an option to buy all the remaining CLM shares, La Moderna said in a news release.
The total cost of the deal is $1.712 billion.

"This transaction is of great importance to CLM, as the participation of B.A.T will strengthen the company in the face of a new and intense global competitive order," Alfonso Romo Garza, chairman of the board of Empresas La Moderna, said in the news release.
La Moderna ADRs were up 1-1/4 to 23-3/4 in New York, while in Mexico, its shares were up 2.60 pesos to 47 pesos.
